items.title: AIR InSILo Open Call 2027: when the hourless seeps
items.funding:
Fund: fully funded
Application fee: €7 (solidarity fee; waivers available for displaced persons)
Programme fee: none
Travel: covered (up to €400)
Stay: covered
Living: covered (honorarium up to €2450)
You pay in total: €7
items.eligibility: Visual artists and practitioners focused on place, matter, memory, body, landscape, time; late-emerging and early mid-career preferred; no current undergraduate/graduate students (PhD candidates eligible); no age limit; language: English, German or Russian; IELTS: not required; NET: not required
items.verifyNote: Confirmed open on official site until 30 Dec 2026; funding details consistent across listings

items.title: Jan van Eyck Academie Residency 2028
items.funding:
Fund: partial
Application fee: €65 (excl. VAT) or free (waived for DAC list countries including India)
Programme fee: €2,750 (excl. VAT) enrolment fee
Travel: you pay
Stay: covered (housing provided; rent deducted from stipend)
Living: partial (monthly stipend €1,500 minus rent)
You pay in total: application fee if applicable + €2,750 + travel (amounts not fully stated)
items.eligibility: Artists, curators, designers, writers, architects and artistic researchers; individuals, duos, collectives; no specific degree required; IELTS: not stated; NET: not required; language: English and Dutch; no age limit
items.verifyNote: Official open call confirmed, deadline 1 Dec 2026 23:59 CET

items.title: Yaddo Artists-in-Residence Program (Winter Cycle)
items.funding:
Fund: fully funded
Application fee: $35
Programme fee: none
Travel: you pay
Stay: covered (room and board)
Living: covered (room and board)
You pay in total: $35 + travel
items.eligibility: Professional creative artists in painting, sculpture, photography, etc.; all nationalities; no enrolled students; IELTS: not stated; NET: not required; language: English; apply once every other year
items.verifyNote: Official deadline 20 Dec 2026; room, board, studio provided; $35 application fee

items.title: DRS Arts Grant 2027
items.funding:
Fund: fully funded
Application fee: free
Programme fee: none
Travel: not stated
Stay: not stated
Living: not stated
You pay in total: not stated
items.eligibility: Indian citizens currently based in India; practising visual artists in any medium; formally trained, independently trained or self-taught; degree not required; aged 18 or above on closing date (categories by age: 30+ for main grant ₹2,40,000, 25–29 for emerging ₹60,000, 18–24 for young ₹60,000); language: English, Hindi, Gujarati or any Indian language; IELTS: not required; NET: not required
items.verifyNote: Official site confirms open 3–30 Nov 2026, no application fee, grants for Indian visual artists based in India

items.title: Spiekeroog Campsite Residency 2027
items.funding:
Fund: fully funded
Application fee: free
Programme fee: none
Travel: covered (ferry costs)
Stay: covered (one-month stay in tent)
Living: covered (honorarium €1,400 + up to €2,400 project costs)
You pay in total: not stated
items.eligibility: Installation, land art, performance, photography and video artists; conceptual temporary projects in public space or participatory formats related to the island; degree not required; age not stated; language: not stated (English/German materials available); IELTS: not stated; NET: not required
items.verifyNote: Official open call confirmed on site, deadline 1 Dec 2026, email applications, funding includes stay, ferry, honorarium and project costs

items.title: Visual Arts - Sounding Like a Mountain
items.org: Banff Centre for Arts and Creativity
items.funding:
Fund: partial
Application fee: $65 CAD
Programme fee: $4,476.78 CAD (after Banff Centre Arts Scholarship; full programme fee $10,033.70 CAD)
Travel: you pay
Stay: covered (included in programme/scholarship)
Living: covered (meals included)
You pay in total: $65 + $4,476.78 + travel
items.eligibility: Individual artists or duos; any stage; formal post-secondary visual arts training or equivalent experience; available for full 5 weeks; practices including painting, sculpture, installation; age 18+; language: English; IELTS: not stated; NET: not required
items.verifyNote: Official site confirms deadline 18 Nov 2026, partial funding via scholarship leaving participant cost of about $4,477 CAD plus application fee and travel

items.title: Artistes en résidence 2027-2028 (Académie de France à Madrid)
items.funding:
Fund: fully funded
Application fee: free
Programme fee: none
Travel: you pay
Stay: covered (housing and studio at Casa de Velázquez)
Living: covered (monthly stipend; exact amount for 2027-28 pending board approval, previously €3,600/month for hosted artists)
You pay in total: travel (stipend figure not yet official)
items.eligibility: Artists with higher artistic studies diploma or significant body of work; primary disciplines: drawing, printmaking, sculpture, painting, architecture, musical composition, choreography, photography, film, video; all nationalities; age 18+; good mastery of French required (application and audition in French); IELTS: not required; NET: not required; language: French
items.verifyNote: Official site confirms open until 27 Nov 2026 13:00 Madrid time; 12 positions; housing and stipend provided; French language required

items.title: IAS CEU Artist in Residence Fellowship 2027/28 (Global Invisible University)
items.org: Institute for Advanced Study at Central European University (IAS CEU)
items.funding:
Fund: fully funded
Application fee: free
Programme fee: none
Travel: you pay
Stay: covered (accommodation at Raoul Wallenberg Guesthouse and/or office space)
Living: covered (net allowance EUR 2,000 per month)
You pay in total: travel + health insurance
items.eligibility: Writers and visual/new media artists (painting, film, digital art, etc.); relevant university degree required; solid portfolio; fluent English; all nationalities encouraged; former IAS CEU fellows ineligible for 7 years; IELTS: not required; NET: not required; language: English
items.verifyNote: Official call open, deadline 30 Nov 2026 23:59 CET; confirmed in PDF call for applications; one visual artist fellowship

items.title: Bernheim Forest Artist in Residence Program 2027
items.funding:
Fund: partial
Application fee: free
Programme fee: none
Travel: you pay
Stay: covered (housing in cabin)
Living: partial ($2,500 stipend)
You pay in total: travel + materials + meals (meals not provided)
items.eligibility: Professional visual and mixed-media artists (including sound/performance with visual elements); emerging or established; all nationalities; undergraduate students not eligible; former residents not eligible to reapply; English working knowledge; IELTS: not stated; NET: not required; language: English
items.verifyNote: Official site confirms applications open, deadline 30 Nov 2026 midnight EST; $2,500 stipend and housing; up to 4 residencies
